rows.grounds: first member of numeral compound qualifying sahasreṣu
locative plural compound denoting realms of birth
past passive participle describing the state of beings implied from context

items.question: Within what vast number of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
Womb-mechanisms constitute the loci of existence.
Beings are tormented within these loci.
items.inference: Torment extends throughout all eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The specific subjects experiencing torment are supplied by the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
